brief: A small desk organizer: a few bases with a bin for pens and a covered top to stand things on. Dress it for use: a mug and a phone on the top, and a pen in the bin.

requirements.requirement: Small desk organizer made of a few hex bases
requirements.evidence: Three Full hex bases (piece at 0,0 / 1,0 / 0,1) in a triangle; caps closed every open outer face and lockJoints bolted the joints. check_build: no issues, meshClash clear.
bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (full-depth, 3-compartment tray) in the origin cell, open top.

requirements.requirement: A covered top to stand things on
requirements.evidence: Covers on the tops of the bases at (1,0) and (0,1) (cover:1,0,0;full;top and cover:0,1,0;full;top), giving two top surfaces.

requirements.requirement: Dress: a mug on the top
requirements.evidence: Mug prop (prop:3) stands on the cover top f25 at (1,0).

requirements.requirement: Dress: a phone on the top
requirements.evidence: Phone prop (prop:4) lies on the cover top f24 at (0,1). Placed on a separate cover because mug and phone could not both fit on one 166x144 mm cover.

requirements.requirement: Dress: a pen in the bin
requirements.evidence: Pen prop (prop:5) stands leaning in a compartment of the pen bin, yawed 90 degrees; it is partly hidden from a top-down view but present.

finish.summary: Built a small desk organizer: three Full hex bases with a 3-compartment pen bin in the origin cell, covers on the two other bases' tops, outer faces capped and joints locked. The mug stands on one cover, the phone lies on the other, and a pen leans in a bin compartment. check_build reports no issues and a clear mesh check. Material suitability (plastic strength, etc.) was not assessed.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
